title: Animal Crossing
blurb: An owl who runs the museum observatory in the Animal Crossing series, teaching players about constellations and trading star fragments.
facts: The player character is a human who lives in a village inhabited by various anthropomorphic animals and can engage in various activities such as fishing, insect catching, and...
The series is known for its open-ended gameplay, humorous dialogue, hourly music, and use of the console's internal clock and calendar to simulate real passage of time.
appearances: Animal Crossing series, since Dōbutsu no Mori (2001, Japan)
